items.question: When did you first invest in that software company?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“When did you first invest in that software company?”，自然应答是“Two years ago.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Two years ago.）。
